description: This file defines an abstract class StaticContentFile that extends ContentFile, including a property for FileContentType with getter and setter methods. It is part of the core content model in the sales manager project.

classes.name: StaticContentFile
classes.description: An abstract class representing static content files with a file content type.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Returns the file content type of this static content file.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Sets the file content type for this static content file.
